Attaching printers to your network is handled in the browser by the CUPS software package and Bixolon PPD files installed on your ViewTouch computer.
After Assigning Static IP Addresses to the network printer(s), we can attach the printer(s) to the network.
The browser will display the printer's Ethernet Settings and allow you to change its Dynamic IP Address to any you choose and change the IP address from DHCP to Static.
From the ViewTouch Desktop (showing Planet Earth) Open the browser, then type the printer's Dynamic IP Address into the browser's URL.
To learn the printer's Dynamic IP Address the printer must be turned on and attached to the network with an Ethernet cable.
Change the printer's Dynamic IP Address to a Static IP Address.

Bixolon ships the SRP-330II printers with a DHCP (Dynamic) network interface.
The interface automatically attaches itself to the network and assigns an IP Address by the Network's Gateway.
Remove the checkmark from the 'DHCP Mode' setting to toggle the IP Address from DHCP to Static.

ViewTouch needs to only know a printer's IP Address and the Queue Name which identifies it.
The IP Address help on this page is for this printer.
The ViewTouch Recomended Thermal Receipt Printer is the Bixolon SRP-330II or SRP-332II.
